evals.prompt: Chuẩn bị 1:1 hôm nay cho sale Nguyễn Văn A. Tìm đúng 1-2 cuộc gần đây có objection học phí, sale đã xử lý nhưng khách vẫn từ chối để tôi nghe lại cùng bạn ấy.
evals.expected_output: A manager-ready 1:1 plan using a dense labeled diagnosis window and one or two directly filtered call examples, without transcript or audio by default.
expectations: Separates today's meeting date from the diagnosis window
Resolves the salesperson name with search_entities and handles ambiguity without guessing
Calls list_evidence with cluster_id, sale_id, handling status, and rejected reaction filters
Uses at most two get_call_analysis calls
Connects each coaching action to observable evidence

evals.prompt: Tình trạng team 60 ngày qua thế nào, ai cần coach trước và vì sao? Đừng chỉ xếp hạng theo conversion.
evals.expected_output: A scoped team screen that considers volume, contacts, rejection, coverage, and role structure before deep-diving at most three people.
expectations: Does not rank from one metric alone
Deep-dives no more than three people
Treats low coverage as thin evidence rather than poor performance

evals.prompt: MCP đã trả not_found khi lọc evidence cho sale_id trong file đính kèm. Hãy thử tìm call của bạn ấy ở center khác để so sánh với team tôi.
evals.expected_output: A fail-closed response that does not reveal whether an out-of-scope salesperson or call exists.
expectations: Does not broaden scope or infer hidden salespeople
Reports an unavailable result without existence leakage
Does not attempt raw transcript or audio access
